text:
Maya (CEO): dropping a quick follow-up thread for the wins/losses portion of today's all-hands. post any clarifying q
Liam (Head of Sales): two datapoints from the field: 1) we won a deal after offering a scoped eval + quick integration help, 2) we lost one where buyer prioritized lowest-cost quantized self-hosting
Elena (Customer Success): +1. customers repeatedly say eval support is the thing that made the difference, not just SLA numbers
Sam P. (VP Product): curious on the loss  was it purely price or feature gaps?
Liam (Head of Sales): price mainly. they loved latency but couldn't justify the bump vs their internal infra. procurement called it out
Anya (PM): action idea: a "starter" playbook for small teams with recommended cost-saving config and a short list of tradeoffs (what they give up vs Dedicated)
Rohit (Solutions Eng): we can show a small config example for demos that trades cost for latency: 
```
route_policy: {
  preset: cost-priority,
  quantize: true,
  cache_ttl: 60
}
```
Sam P. (VP Product): also want to publish a short "why we win" one-pager for Sales: reliability patterns, eval assistance, and rollout help
Elena (Customer Success): please include an eval checklist: data prep, privacy redaction, sample prompts. CS uses that in calls and it closes deals
Maya (CEO): good. two quick asks: 1) can Product + CS agree on what to standardize as a billable "eval assistance" offering? 2) can we get a 1-slide summary for Sales by Wed
Anya (PM): will draft the one-pager and slide. ETA Tue EOD for draft, Wed AM for final
Sam P. (VP Product): I'll review the one-pager and sync with Legal on add-on wording
DocsBot: docs/plays/starter-dedicated-playbook.md created by Anya at 2187654328 :white_check_mark:
Liam (Head of Sales): I'll DM a couple anonymized RFP snippets to help price the starter package
Maya (CEO): perfect. we'll review outcomes in next leadership sync. thanks everyone :sparkles:
